races.name: CAA Stellar Lily Agnes EBF Conditions Stakes (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Black Treasure
runners_data.note: Sole newcomer faces three confirmed front-runners but Blackbeard progeny often show natural pace from debut
runners_data.comment: 30,000euros yearling; sole newcomer in the field; heed the market signals
runners_data.spotlight: 30,000euros yearling; by Blackbeard; related to a few 2yo scorers (7f/1m) but inexperience may count against her, being the sole newcomer in the field; check the betting for further guidance.

runners_data.name: Adonius
runners_data.note: Front-runner with two-from-two record but faces proper pace pressure for first time under penalty weight
runners_data.comment: Two from two, namely wins at Musselburgh; big player from the inside gate
runners_data.spotlight: Two from two, namely wins at Musselburgh (5f, soft/good to soft) by 7l then a neck; made all and always doing enough under a penalty last time; big player from the inside gate.

runners_data.name: Wait Geordie
runners_data.note: Made all on debut but Hugo Palmer's 31-day gap suggests targeted placement at Chester specialist track
runners_data.comment: Once-raced novice winner (at Bath) who represents a local yard that targets Chester
runners_data.spotlight: Notable contender, being a once-raced novice winner who represents a local yard that targets Chester; made all at Bath (5f, good) and should be handy from his low draw; commands respect.

runners_data.name: Hickory Lad
runners_data.note: Fresh from recent Musselburgh victory but drawn widest of the three speed horses on inside rail
runners_data.comment: Made all at Musselburgh last week, building on his Thirsk effort
runners_data.spotlight: Made all to beat two rivals at Musselburgh (5f, good) last week, going one better than he did at Thirsk; faces competition for the lead to his inside but is otherwise one of the main form contenders.

runners_data.name: Cailin Aine
runners_data.note: Prominent runner ideally positioned to benefit from expected pace collapse between the three leaders
runners_data.comment: Recorded only an ordinary RPR in finishing third at Redcar
runners_data.spotlight: Showed ability with third-place finish at Redcar (5f, good to firm) but recorded only an ordinary RPR; drawn wider than the main form contenders and faces a difficult task.

runners_data.name: Yahaira
runners_data.note: Hold-up style completely wrong for this pace scenario and brings poorest recent form
runners_data.comment: Brings the worst form, having posted a duck egg at Bath
runners_data.spotlight: Brings the worst form, having posted a duck egg at Bath (5f, good); perhaps needed the run but this looks a stiff assignment.

runners_data.name: Final Appeal
runners_data.note: Proven left-handed track winner whose prominent style suits the strong pace setup perfectly
runners_data.comment: Gained his AW win at left-handed, turning Wolverhampton; looks a very suitable type
runners_data.spotlight: Already proven on a turning, left-handed track having recorded a comfortable win from the front at Wolverhampton (5f, AW) to build on his Nottingham effort; looks a very suitable type.

runners_data.name: Fern Clyde
runners_data.note: Prominent runner for in-form Easterby yard but modest form rating suggests limited winning chance

races.paceDynamic: Hickory Lad, Adonius, and Wait Geordie will battle for early supremacy, with all three confirmed front-runners setting a fierce gallop over Chester's tight 5f circuit. This guaranteed strong pace will put maximum pressure on stamina reserves in the closing stages. The relentless tempo created by this trio of speed horses will set up the race perfectly for prominent racers who can track the pace without getting embroiled in the early speed duel. This race shape strongly favours PROMINENT runners who can position themselves just behind the battling leaders.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Late
scenarios.trigger: If the three front-runners burn each other out in a speed duel
scenarios.body: The strong early gallop takes its toll and those who raced prominently inherit the lead in the final furlong. Final Appeal and Cailin Aine are perfectly positioned to capitalise.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one of the pace-setters can break clear of the speed battle
scenarios.body: Adonius or Hickory Lad proves strongest in the early exchanges and maintains enough for victory. Their proven ability to make all gives them the edge over their front-running rivals.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Newcomer Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Black Treasure shows natural early pace despite inexperience
scenarios.body: The Blackbeard filly overcomes her debut status to track the leaders and strike late with fresh legs. Her breeding suggests she has the class to exploit the pace collapse.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is even stronger than expected and catches everyone
scenarios.body: Fern Clyde or Yahaira get the perfect tow behind the speed battle and find unexpected improvement. The severe pace allows a horse with lesser form to sneak through.

watchPoints.text: Watch if any of Hickory Lad, Adonius or Wait Geordie breaks clear early as this will negate the pace advantage
Monitor Black Treasure's market moves as any confidence would suggest she has shown serious ability at home
Check Final Appeal's positioning turning in as he's proven on left-handed tracks and suits the pace shape
Watch for traffic problems involving the prominent runners if the front three spread across the track
Observe if Yahaira gets any early position as her hold-up style faces impossible task in this pace scenario

races.name: Join Ladbrokes Bet 5 Get 30 Earl Grosvenor Handicap

runners_data.name: Supido
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from 168-day break for in-form Ian Williams, needs the run but has strong course form
runners_data.comment: Well treated on form early last season; has good draw and B Loughnane riding; contender
runners_data.spotlight: Fifth over C&D (good) at this meeting last year on his first outing for Ian Williams and followed that with a very good fifth of 30 in the Britannia at Royal Ascot (1m, good to firm); failed to match that level later in the campaign but his mark has dipped and dangerous if bouncing back to form after a winter break; a good draw and Billy Loughnane in the saddle are positives.

runners_data.name: Snow Master
runners_data.note: Confirmed front runner who can over-race in better company, long absence a concern but has winning form at trip
runners_data.comment: Promising for Tom Dascombe and interesting new recruit for top yard having been gelded
runners_data.spotlight: Impressed when winning two fast-ground novices at Yarmouth (7f/1m) just over a year apart; too keen when sixth to Zeus Olympios in 1m Group races at Haydock (led) and Newmarket (held up) in the autumn; has switched from Tom Dascombe to Andrew Balding ahead of reappearance (same owners); also gelded which could help to settle him down; Double Rush's exploits this spring underline the yard's prowess with new recruits and this one has similar potential.

runners_data.name: Divine Libra
runners_data.note: Strong Chester specialist with two course wins, hold-up style suits expected pace scenario perfectly
runners_data.comment: Good Chester record includes 7f win at this meeting in 2024; should be sharper for return
runners_data.spotlight: Has gained both handicap wins at Chester, including over the bare 7f at this meeting (good) in May 2024; respectable fifth in this last year; a reappearance run over 6f at the Newmarket Craven meeting could have put him spot on for this; likely to be in the mix here again.

runners_data.name: Thunder Roar
runners_data.note: Proven stayer whose hold-up style is ideal, but concerning recent form on softer surfaces
runners_data.comment: Very useful but below par both runs this year and has the outside stall
runners_data.spotlight: Very useful handicapper who added to his tally with a 1m win at Ayr (soft) last September; ended that campaign with an excellent second at York but not at his best in two comeback outings in March; third on his previous visit to Chester but will do well to match or better that from the outside stall.

runners_data.name: City House
runners_data.note: Recent Dundalk second suggests return to form, hold-up style suits but unfamiliar headgear applied
runners_data.comment: Creditable fifth on turf latest but more needed here; does have a handy draw, though
runners_data.spotlight: Smart turf form at up to in Bahrain for George Scott early last year; best run for Adrian McGuinness when second over 6f at Dundalk in February and bounced back from a lesser effort at Newcastle on Good Friday when fifth of 12 on return to turf at Naas (6f, good) last Monday; has a handy draw but not obviously well treated on recent exploits.

runners_data.name: Percy's Lad
runners_data.note: Defending champion with excellent Chester record, prominent style suits course but long absence worrying
runners_data.comment: Won this in 2024; led for long way on comeback run; could be primed for another bold bid
runners_data.spotlight: Prominent racer with a very good Chester record, including a win in this race on good to firm in 2024 (also third on soft in 2023); off for 20 months prior to finishing well held at the Newmarket Craven meeting three weeks ago but he led for long enough to think plenty of ability remains and this has presumably been the target; could bounce back to form with a bang.

runners_data.name: Bellarchi
runners_data.note: In-form prominent racer with career-best recent win, perfectly suited to this trip and tactical scenario
runners_data.comment: In career-best form with two Musselburgh wins last month; can't rule out in current mood
runners_data.spotlight: Last four wins at Musselburgh, including two last month, latterly producing a career-best performance to see off ten rivals over 1m on good; runner-up on only Chester visit; a further 4lb rise demands even more but can't rule out in her current mood.

runners_data.name: Al Shabab Storm
runners_data.note: Listed winner here previously but long break and new stable connections create uncertainty
runners_data.comment: Course Listed winner at peak but ended 2025 out of form; new yard
runners_data.spotlight: Won a 7f Listed race here (good to soft) for Andrew Balding in 2024; still capable of smart performances for Marco Botti last year but wasn't at his best on final two starts, including in a course seller; sold for 45,000gns in October; a Group 1 entry at Royal Ascot suggests new connections are hopeful he retains all his ability.

runners_data.name: Partisan Hero
runners_data.note: Natural front runner whose style suits Chester perfectly, recent Bahrain form over shorter trips encouraging
runners_data.comment: Second in this from wide stall in 2025 and this front-runner is much better drawn now
runners_data.spotlight: All wins have been over 7f and 1m so it arguably bodes well for his prospects here that he's performed well over sprint trips in Bahrain this year; very good second in this race (good ground) last year from an outside stall and this front-runner has fared a lot better with the draw this time; top of the list.

runners_data.name: The Angel King
runners_data.note: French winner making stable debut, hold-up style suits but needs significant improvement from Haydock debut
runners_data.comment: Useful dual 7f winner in France but no obvious promise on recent yard debut
runners_data.spotlight: Useful dual 7f winner (both on ground slower than good) in France but well held on recent 7f Haydock stable debut; needs to have come on a lot in a short time.

runners_data.name: God Of War
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse slightly below last winning mark, recent turf form disappointing but trip suits
runners_data.comment: Below par latest but on winning mark and second at this meeting last year; can't discount
runners_data.spotlight: Never involved back on turf at Newmarket last month; however, he returned with two respectable efforts on AW prior to that and the fact he's dipped to 1lb below the mark he defied at Sandown (7f, soft) last summer and was runner-up at this meeting last year make him a dangerous one to discount.

runners_data.name: Brighton Boy
runners_data.note: Course winner last year but in seller grade, hold-up style suits expected pace but big class jump
runners_data.comment: C&D winner; should come on for recent yard debut but stall 12 is far from ideal.
runners_data.spotlight: Had a below-par Al Shabab Storm in behind when winning a useful C&D seller (soft) for Andrew Balding last September; made a respectable start for new connections when seventh of 12 over 7f at Thirsk (good) 18 days ago; entitled to come on for the outing but the draw hasn't done him any favours here.

runners_data.name: Solar Aclaim
runners_data.note: Sprint specialist trying new trip after wind surgery, prominent style helps but stamina major question
runners_data.comment: 6f course winner but new trip and wide stall enough reasons to oppose; has had wind op
runners_data.spotlight: Useful sprinter, landing soft-ground wins over 6f here and 5f at Yarmouth last summer; has had wind surgery ahead of reappearance; a new trip and a wide stall and are enough reasons to look elsewhere.

runners_data.name: Lir Speciale
runners_data.note: Finished 2024 in excellent form over 7f, hold-up style perfect but 39-day break creates fitness doubt
runners_data.comment: Two 7f Doncaster wins in mud in late 2025; also good third of 22 there on 1m reappearance
runners_data.spotlight: Ended his 2025 campaign with a heavy-ground 7f double at Doncaster; underlined how well he operates on Town Moor with a good third of 22 in the Spring Mile (good to soft) on reappearance in March; claims if he can reproduce that sort of form at Chester (first visit).

races.paceDynamic: Snow Master and Partisan Hero will ensure a solid early gallop over this testing 7½f trip at Chester. Snow Master has shown a tendency to overrace in Group company but should settle better in handicap grade, while Partisan Hero's front-running style perfectly suits Chester's tight configuration. The sustained pace will create a genuine test of stamina, with the field likely stringing out through the final two furlongs. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses with proven stamina who can finish strongly when others tire.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Gallop Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Snow Master and Partisan Hero maintain a relentless pace through halfway
scenarios.body: The early leaders will weaken dramatically in the final furlong, creating gaps for closers with proven stamina. Hold-up horses like Thunder Roar and Divine Libra can exploit their superior finishing kick when the pace collapses.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Moderate Pace Kick
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace steadies after an initial burst from the front pair
scenarios.body: The race becomes more tactical with prominent racers able to track the leaders comfortably before delivering sustained challenges. Percy's Lad and Bellarchi can use their positioning to time their moves perfectly when the real racing begins.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Snow Master or Partisan Hero finds the right rhythm and the field fails to close
scenarios.body: One of the pace-setters maintains their advantage by dictating terms and keeping enough in reserve for the finish. The leader's stamina proves superior to the closing efforts of the hold-up horses behind.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Sprint Finish Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes extremely sedate with multiple horses still in contention turning in
scenarios.body: The race develops into a cavalry charge with pure speed becoming decisive over stamina. Horses with tactical speed like Lir Speciale can produce devastating late bursts when the field bunches.

watchPoints.text: Snow Master could over-race early as he did in Group company at Haydock, potentially compromising his stamina reserves
Percy's Lad returning from 20-month absence despite being defending champion with excellent Chester record
Solar Aclaim stepping up significantly in trip after wind surgery with no recent form guide
Divine Libra and Thunder Roar both ideally positioned if the early pace creates the expected collapse scenario
Partisan Hero's recent sprint form in Bahrain could translate perfectly to Chester's unique tactical demands

races.name: Weatherbys Cheshire Oaks (Listed Race) (Fillies)

runners_data.name: I'm The One
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner with impressive debut win but faces significant step up in class against Group-race experienced fillies
runners_data.comment: Impressive debut performance in Newbury maiden; favourite for the Oaks; highly respected
runners_data.spotlight: Nicely bred filly, by Sea The Stars and the first foal of a German 1m4f Group 1 winner; impressively justified favouritism in Newbury maiden (1m2f, good) last month for a highly promising debut, striding clear in the final 1f to score by 6l; very bright prospect who is currently ante-post favourite for the Oaks and commands major respect.

runners_data.name: A La Prochaine
runners_data.note: Hold-up type returning from 193-day break with only one career start, making fitness a question mark despite her talent
runners_data.comment: Appeared to win with something in hand at Newbury in sole 2yo start; promising sort
runners_data.spotlight: Lope De Vega filly who cost 550,000gns as a yearling; appeared to win with something in hand at Newbury (1m, soft) in sole 2yo start; promising sort who could make her mark at this higher level, albeit rather lacks the dazzle of the other once-raced contender, I'm The One.

runners_data.name: Amelia Earhart
runners_data.note: Prominent racer with solid Group-race form who handles good going well and brings valuable big-race experience

runners_data.name: Winged One
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning after 197 days who lacks Oaks entry unlike rivals, suggesting connections rate her below this level
runners_data.comment: Big step forward to win on AW but perhaps brings the least ability and/or potential
runners_data.spotlight: Took a big step forward to win well at Newcastle (1m, AW) in the second of her two autumn starts; however, she's the only runner who isn't entered in the Oaks and, as her bare form backs up, perhaps brings the least ability and/or potential.

runners_data.name: Sugar Island
runners_data.note: Prominent type who carries 5lb penalty but has proven middle-distance form and handles the going conditions

races.paceDynamic: I'm The One will dictate terms from the front with no obvious pace pressure in this small field. Sugar Island and Amelia Earhart will likely sit prominent but won't challenge the early gallop, while A La Prochaine and Winged One are confirmed hold-up types who need others to create the pace. With just one natural leader and limited early speed, this sets up a moderate tempo that will quicken late. This tactical scenario strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can control their position early, as the hold-up horses face a searching test to make up ground.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Runner Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If I'm The One gets an uncontested lead and sets her own fractions
scenarios.body: She can dictate a pace that suits her stamina strengths and prove hard to peg back when the field comes hunting. The lack of early pressure allows her to save energy for a sustained finish that the closers struggle to match.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Take Control
scenarios.trigger: If Sugar Island or Amelia Earhart press forward to challenge I'm The One early
scenarios.body: This creates a more honest gallop that could find out the leader's stamina while setting up perfectly for these proven middle-distance types. The increased pace will make life harder for the hold-up horses to recover from their customary slow starts.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Superior Class
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes a crawl throughout
scenarios.body: A La Prochaine and Winged One get the tactical race they need with a sprint finish that allows superior acceleration to triumph. However, both face fitness questions after long layoffs which makes this scenario less reliable than their running styles suggest.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Stalemate Favours Experience
scenarios.trigger: If jockeys play waiting games and nobody wants to commit early
scenarios.body: The race becomes a test of tactical nous and experience where Amelia Earhart's Group race experience tells. This scrappy scenario could catch out the less experienced runners who haven't faced such tactical battles.

watchPoints.text: A La Prochaine and Winged One both return from 190+ day breaks making their fitness levels a significant unknown
I'm The One faces a massive class jump from maiden company to Listed level against Group-race experienced rivals
Sugar Island carries the only penalty in the race which could prove decisive in a tight finish
The small field size means any tactical errors or poor breaks will be magnified with limited opportunities to recover
Watch for how aggressively the O'Brien pair are ridden as their tactics will shape the entire race narrative

races.name: Boodles Chester Vase Stakes (Group 3) (Colts & Geldings)

runners_data.name: Water To Wine
runners_data.note: Non-runner
runners_data.comment: He does not have the Derby entry, but an exciting prospect after 1m3f Newbury maiden win
runners_data.spotlight: Kingman half-brother to winners Naga (1m/1m2f; RPR 91) and Inwi (French 1m1f); dam French 1m1f-1m4f scorer (including Group 2; 109), half-sister to Hong Kong 1m4f Group 1 winner; evens for eight-runner maiden at Newbury (1m3f, good) 18 days ago and asserted in highly promising fashion; this race is a vault up in class and he does not have the Derby entry, but an exciting prospect.

runners_data.name: Benvenuto Cellini
runners_data.note: Front runner with proven Group 2 form who benefits from 193 days off and Ryan Moore's retention
runners_data.comment: Most impressive in 1m Group 2 at Leopardstown in September; Group 1 Futurity 3rd on heavy
runners_data.spotlight: Made all in a maiden last July and most impressive in four-runner Group 2 at Leopardstown (1m, good to yielding) in September; made favourite for the Derby on the back of that, and still has that position despite his third of five behind two stablemates when warm favourite for Group 1 Futurity at Doncaster (1m) in October, which was on heavy ground; sister Giselle won last year's Lingfield Oaks Trial (Oaks fifth); their trainer is the first one to turn to for winners of these Chester Derby and Oaks trials; hard to beat.

runners_data.name: Del Maro
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who needs pace but showed progressive form as a 2-year-old for in-form Charlie Appleby
runners_data.comment: Off the mark on reappearance; best form when third in Group 3 at Newmarket (1m2f) as 2yo
runners_data.spotlight: Derby entry; progressive as 2yo (hooded three times) while always finding one or two too good for him, in the last instance when third behind two Aidan O'Brien-trained colts in Group 3 at Newmarket (1m2f, good to firm); it's unlikely he had to reproduce that form when seeing off a newcomer by half a length in novice at Yarmouth (1m2f, good) on reappearance, at 4-7; not the most exciting on that evidence but likely to relish this extra distance.

runners_data.name: Mr Colonel
runners_data.note: Prominent racer returning quickly from Newmarket Group 3 fifth, cheekpieces tried last time
runners_data.comment: Just over 2l behind Del Maro on final 2yo start; short-head win on return; 1m4f+ can suit
runners_data.spotlight: Beaten a neck on first two runs before his front-running and rallying fifth of eight in Group 3 at Newmarket (1m2f, good to firm; sole run in cheekpieces) in October, just over 2l behind third-placed Del Maro; clear before halfway when 11-10 for a four-runner novice at Redcar (1m2f, good to firm) 16 days ago but had to battle for a short-head win; while he still looks a work in progress and 1m4f+ is likely to suit, he'd be a surprise winner of this.

runners_data.name: Proposition
runners_data.note: Prominent runner making seasonal reappearance after 191 days off with strong Ballydoyle pedigree
runners_data.comment: Galway 2yo maiden winner (7f, soft to heavy); surely set for big improvement; cheekpieces
runners_data.spotlight: Has big-race entries; Frankel close relation to multiple Group 1-winning fillies Magical (up to 1m4f) and Rhododendron (up to 1m2f); well held on debut but second favourite for a maiden at Galway (7f, soft to heavy) later in October and eventually got the better of an odds-on stablemate who's not been seen since; cheekpieces go on and he's presumably the stable second string, but surely set for big improvement over middle distances this term.

runners_data.name: Mr Vettori
runners_data.note: Prominent type who hung right on last two starts and represents Irish trainer Jessica Harrington
runners_data.comment: Useful middle-distance prospect, at the least, but this race demands a marked step forward
runners_data.spotlight: Irish Derby entry whose dam is sister to Yorkshire Oaks and Vermeille winner Warm Heart; hung markedly right on his last two starts as a 2yo when 50-1 second at the Curragh (good) to subsequent Group 1 Futurity winner Hawk Mountain and going one better in another 1m maiden at Gowran (heavy);  made a satisfactory return when second of four in a conditions event at Cork (10.5f, good) 12 days ago; can build on that but he needs to does so in a major way.

runners_data.name: Royal Standard
runners_data.note: Non-runner
runners_data.comment: Nothing special about the form of 9.4f AW win but he was much the strongest in final 1f
runners_data.spotlight: Second 2yo start was better than debut and he reappeared with a front-running win when 4-6 in a four-runner maiden at Wolverhampton (9.4f, AW) six weeks ago; edged right off the final turn last time and was asked serious questions, with nothing special about the form, but he was much the strongest in the final 1f, so 1m4f will surely help; tongue-tie is now added.

races.paceDynamic: Benvenuto Cellini is the sole confirmed front runner and should dictate terms without pressure from flag to finish. Mr Colonel, Proposition, and Mr Vettori will sit prominent but none are confirmed pace pressers, meaning the O'Brien runner can bowl along at sustainable fractions. Del Maro and the hold-up horses will need the pace to be strong enough to set up their finishing kicks over Chester's unique sharp turns. This controlled tempo heavily favours the front runner and prominent racers who can stay close to the pace without getting into a battle.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Benvenuto Cellini Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Benvenuto Cellini gets an uncontested lead and maintains his stamina
scenarios.body: The Ballydoyle runner can replicate his Leopardstown Group 2 victory where he made all unchallenged. The combination of Ryan Moore's tactical nous and the horse's proven front-running ability makes him extremely hard to peg back on this tight track.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners can sit close enough to challenge turning for home
scenarios.body: Mr Colonel or Proposition could track the leader and have enough left to mount a challenge in the final two furlongs. The sustained pace would suit their racing style while not being strong enough to fully set up the closers.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-up Horse Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is stronger than expected due to tactical pressure
scenarios.body: Del Maro could benefit from a more searching gallop that would stretch Benvenuto Cellini's stamina reserves. His progressive profile and William Buick's big-race experience make him the most likely closer to capitalize.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes crawling slow with no one willing to challenge early
scenarios.body: The race could become a sprint finish where tactical positioning matters more than sustained pace. This would open up opportunities for any horse that gets a perfect trip regardless of usual running style.

watchPoints.text: Benvenuto Cellini must be watched for any signs of ring rustiness after 193 days absence from the track
Mr Colonel's tendency to race in cheekpieces last time suggests potential focus issues that could resurface
Proposition's seasonal reappearance for O'Brien after nearly seven months off needs monitoring for fitness
Del Maro requires a strong early pace to set up his finishing kick but may not get it with one front runner
Mr Vettori's right-handed hanging tendency could be problematic on Chester's tight left-handed configuration

races.name: American Holidays Handicap

runners_data.name: Do Bronxs
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from 236-day layoff with something to prove after disappointing Group 1 effort
runners_data.comment: Possibly flattered by apparent peak effort; something to prove off his mark
runners_data.spotlight: Highly tried after his winning debut last term; possibly flattered by apparent peak effort (last of five in Irish Group 1) and has something to prove off his mark in this handicap debut; gelded since last run.

runners_data.name: Tricky Tel
runners_data.note: Prominent style suits but has been disappointing away from Chester despite winning twice here previously
runners_data.comment: Return to Chester may prompt a resurgence; 2-2 here, both starts last May
runners_data.spotlight: Career commenced with two wins at Chester (5.5f/6f, good) last May; not in the same form elsewhere subsequently but the return to this venue, combined with a gelding operation, may prompt a resurgence; one of three runners for his local stable.

runners_data.name: Angel Love
runners_data.note: Prominent runner stepping up from all-weather with unproven turf credentials at this level
runners_data.comment: Won at Wolverhampton in final 2yo start; could take well to Chester and improve further
runners_data.spotlight: Comfortably justified favouritism at left-handed, turning Wolverhampton (kept to 6f on AW) in final 2yo start, stepping up on her placed efforts; interesting contender on turf/handicap debut, being one who could take well to Chester and improve further.

runners_data.name: Temple Of Athena
runners_data.note: Prominent runner stretching back up to 6f from 5f specialist campaign with solid Chester form
runners_data.comment: Three-time 5f winner, including at Chester; return to 6f presents a question mark
runners_data.spotlight: Campaigned mostly over 5f, winning three times, including at Chester (good to soft); not disgraced in Listed event at Bath most recently; well drawn but the return to 6f presents a question mark.

runners_data.name: Alaminos
runners_data.note: Prominent type with strong recent form including unlucky second at Pontefract on good going
runners_data.comment: Unlucky second at Pontefract on handicap/seasonal debut; still open to further improvement
runners_data.spotlight: Thrice-raced colt whose form features a debut success last August and neck second, looking unlucky, at Pontefract (6f, good; had traffic issues) on handicap/seasonal debut; remains open to further improvement and commands respect.

runners_data.name: Ruby's Angel
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from 242-day absence but has winning form at this track and trip
runners_data.comment: Won competitive nursery at the York Ebor festival in last turf attempt; likely player

runners_data.name: Silent Strike

runners_data.name: Watcha Snoop

runners_data.name: Saffron Dandy

runners_data.spotlight: Scored on turf last term but showed her peak RPRs with two AW wins this year; not disgraced on finals day at Newcastle last time; bit to prove off current mark returned to this sphere.

runners_data.name: Arduis Invicta

runners_data.spotlight: Campaigned at Listed level, with mixed results, since scoring off 13lb lower in last handicap attempt; peak figure may not be reliable and she needs to prove current mark is appropriate.

runners_data.name: Cherry Baker

runners_data.comment: Sole 6f attempt resulted in ready win at Southwell; unexposed over this distance
runners_data.spotlight: Returns to a more realistic level on handicap debut, having faced a stiff task (well beaten) in the Nell Gwyn on reappearance; sole 6f attempt resulted in ready win at Southwell (AW) in final 2yo outing; unexposed over this distance.

races.paceDynamic: Silent Strike, Cherry Baker and Evie Ross will ensure a strong gallop from the start, with 6 other prominent runners (Do Bronxs, Tricky Tel, Angel Love, Temple Of Athena, Alaminos, Ruby's Angel) creating significant early congestion. The pace will be honest throughout this 6f test, likely stretching the field and causing traffic problems approaching the final 2f as the prominent pack bunches. This genuine gallop and inevitable crowding will strongly favour the hold-up horses Watcha Snoop and Go Vince Go, who can sit off the pace and find cleaner runs when it matters most.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Prosper
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent pack creates the expected traffic jam 2f out...
scenarios.body: Watcha Snoop and Go Vince Go benefit from cleaner runs as the pace collapses ahead of them. The strong early gallop sets up perfectly for their patient tactics to pay dividends.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tactical Success
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners secures an uncontested position...
scenarios.body: Temple Of Athena or Alaminos could profit from tactical speed to avoid the worst congestion. Their experience in competitive handicaps gives them the edge in a messy finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If the front three go too fast and tie each other up...
scenarios.body: The moderate pace-setters burn out leaving the race to prominent horses with tactical speed. Angel Love and Ruby's Angel can capitalize on their more patient prominent styles.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Cherry Baker or Evie Ross get uncontested leads...
scenarios.body: One of the leaders gets first run and holds on despite the strong pace behind them. Their class advantages over this field could see them through in a driving finish.

races.name: TMT Group Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)

runners_data.name: Arabian Desert
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with highest RPR but carries seconditis burden and was turned over at 1-8 last time
runners_data.comment: Sets the standard on his 2yo Group 3 effort; turned over at 1-8 in maiden on reappearance
runners_data.spotlight: Comes with a degree of risk having been turned over at odds of 1-8 in Pontefract maiden (1m) on seasonal debut, extending his seconditis; otherwise again sets a useful standard on his Group 3 effort at Newbury (7f, soft) last October; siblings include a 1m2f winner.

runners_data.name: El Nay

runners_data.spotlight: Both starts on AW, close second over 1m at Lingfield then third over 7f at Kempton; again has place possibilities on form and any progress would give him a fighting chance of winning; new trip is the question mark, judged on breeding.

runners_data.name: Alfaraz

runners_data.name: Outback Legend

runners_data.spotlight: 850,000gns yearling purchase who is by Frankel and whose siblings include Irish Derby and St Leger winner Hurricane Lane; promising second of nine in Nottingham event (1m2f, good); may need further in due course but still warrants respect, being one who has significant potential.

runners_data.name: Sottsfield

runners_data.comment: Brings the worst form, based on his 2yo effort
runners_data.spotlight: Brings the worst form, having finished only eighth of 12 at Newcastle (1m, AW) in sole 2yo start; handicaps will likely be his ideal scene in due course.

runners_data.name: Norman Invasion
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning after 181 days off, gelded since last seen and has shown ability
runners_data.comment: Gelded since his 2yo runs; several of today's rivals have achieved bigger figures
runners_data.spotlight: Gelded since 2yo runs that comprised a fifth-place finish in Ascot maiden (7f) won by high-class prospect and close third with hood fitted at Newcastle (1m, AW); headgear now removed; several of today's rivals have achieved bigger figures.

races.paceDynamic: Alfaraz would have been the sole genuine front-runner but is now a non-runner, leaving Arabian Desert and El Nay as the most likely early leaders in a field lacking natural pace. With both having prominent rather than pure lead styles, they may settle into a steadier rhythm early before quickening. Norman Invasion and Outback Legend will track behind this pair, while Tornado Tower's hold-up style sees him held up for a late challenge. This moderate pace setup strongly favours prominent runners and hold-up horses who can finish, with front-runners having been removed from the equation.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Steady Pace Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Arabian Desert and El Nay settle into a comfortable rhythm early without serious pressure.
scenarios.body: The lack of genuine pace allows hold-up horses to get into contention as the race develops into a sprint finish. Tornado Tower's Gosden polish and Frankel breeding shine through in this tactical affair.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Duel Develops
scenarios.trigger: If Arabian Desert and El Nay engage in a sustained battle from the home turn.
scenarios.body: Their duel sets up the race perfectly for Norman Invasion and any other closer to sweep past in the final furlong. The early leaders compound each other while opening the door for late runners.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Arabian Desert Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Arabian Desert can dictate terms from the front without serious challenge.
scenarios.body: His superior RPR of 105 tells as he controls the race from pillar to post in a truly-run contest. El Nay and the others struggle to bridge the gap to a horse who has found his level.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is exceptionally slow with all prominent horses going too steadily.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy scramble where any horse can win regardless of ability or style. Outback Legend or even Sottsfield could emerge from the pack in a blanket finish.

races.paceDynamic: Bell Shot takes them along as the sole confirmed front runner, setting a sustainable gallop without early pressure. Behind him, six horses (Sujet, Dance In The Storm, Midnight Strike, Silky Wilkie, A War Eagle, Goldmoyne) will create congestion in the prominent positions, leading to inevitable traffic problems turning for home. The large hold-up brigade including Miami Matrix, Arctic Thunder, Crimson Spirit, Spangled Mac, Pietro, Rare Change and Huscal will need significant luck in running on Chester's tight circuit. This race strongly favours prominent racers who can secure a clean passage early and avoid the late scramble for racing room.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Traffic Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the six prominent horses create a wall behind Bell Shot and bunch up approaching the home turn
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get blocked and those with early positioning dominate the finish. Clean journeys from the prominent group prove decisive on Chester's unique layout.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Bell Shot Wire Job
scenarios.trigger: If Bell Shot gets an uncontested lead and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The front runner exploits the lack of early pace pressure and holds off late challengers who come too late. His stamina from longer trips and tactical advantage prove crucial.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Hero Lucky
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses come back to Bell Shot early and create a fast pace that sets up the race for closers
scenarios.body: The strong early gallop finds out the prominent horses and allows the best hold-up performers with clean runs to surge late. Class tells in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Bell Shot goes too slow early and gets swamped by the prominent group before halfway
scenarios.body: A tactical mess develops with no genuine pace, turning it into a sprint finish where the best turn of foot wins. The race becomes a lottery decided by position at the furlong pole.

watchPoints.text: Watch for Bell Shot getting loose on the lead - if uncontested he could steal this from the front
Monitor the prominent group (Sujet, Dance In The Storm, A War Eagle, Goldmoyne) for early positioning battles that could compromise them all
Pietro and Crimson Spirit need watching for clean passages - both have the class but need racing room at Chester
Dance In The Storm's tendency to race too freely could be amplified after 221 days off under Oisin Murphy
First-time headgear on Bell Shot (blinkers) and Huscal (tongue-tie) could significantly alter their performances
